item.name: Identity Security E2E
item.description: Flujo E2E para demo en video: register -> login -> block -> blocked login -> events -> unblock -> login -> auto-block.

exec: const adminPayload = { sub: "admin-e2e", permissions: ["USER_BLOCK", "USER_UNBLOCK", "SECURITY_EVENT_READ"], iat: now, exp: now + 3600 };
const token = sign({ alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT" }, adminPayload, secret);
const svcPayload = { sub: "payment-service", token_type: "service", scope: "identity:auto_block", iat: now, exp: now + 3600 };
const token = sign({ alg: "HS256", typ: "JWT" }, svcPayload, secret);
